recordedProductIssues: Dim scrim and masked black bars on the review screen; yellow ring and badge on Cancel button are recorded and small

defects.problem: Screenshot occupies a small top-left tile with a large empty band between it and the caption line; at feed size the billing form is unreadable and the hook rests only on the headline.
defects.fix: Enlarge the screenshot tile to fill the empty band (layout only, no zoom of content) or drop the empty band.

defects.problem: Dissolve frame shows the old headline ghosted over the new screen, a muddy overlap at feed size.
defects.fix: Shorten the dissolve or fade the headline out before the screen dims.

defects.problem: The Cancel button in the main tile is about 40 px wide; the inset crop does the work but its caption is tiny, so muted viewers lose the 'recorded, iPhone 16' label.
defects.fix: Raise the inset caption size and merge it with the main caption.

oneLineVerdict: Clear hook idea and stable, but the content is small and the layout leaves dead space; reads as a clean slide, not top craft.
